title: membraneShortlist operation
description: FROM A FUNCTIONAL CLASS TO THE COMMERCIAL ELEMENTS THAT DO IT. Hard filters on each registered module record (membrane of the class's type, a spiral element, ONE rated test of the solute, its rated rejection inside the class band, declared P_max / T_max / pH limits at the student's feed), then each survivor is re-rated on the module itself at the STUDENT'S conditions (its water permeance and intrinsic rejection derived from its own rated test; the feed flow found so ONE element delivers the asked recovery), and the feed-flow and pressure-drop limits filter again. Every criterion is published side by side per module -- permeate flow, observed rejection, permeate concentration, flux, P/flux, hydraulic energy per m3, feed flow, pressure drop, margins -- in ALPHABETICAL order of the module name. There is no score, no weight and no rank, and a record's `partner` / `dataVerifiedBy` is never read. Diagnostics: n_candidates, n_pass, n_excluded and, per re-rated module, <module>__<criterion> (hyphens in the name become underscores). Also writes the CSV of `output.file`. One solute, one element, a constant intrinsic rejection fixed at the sheet's one test. Witness shortlist01_class_to_modules (gate check_membrane_shortlist).

class.title: Functional class
class.description: A `kind membraneClass` record (NF_OPEN, NF_DIVALENT_SELECTIVE, NF_TIGHT, BWRO_HIGH_FLUX, BWRO_HIGH_REJECTION, SWRO). A commercial module here refuses. It must rate the solute (carry a band for it).

solute.title: Solute
solute.description: The salt the choice is about: a component of the case that the class rates. Required.

tiers.title: Catalogue tiers that are candidates
tiers.description: Which tiers of the module registry contribute candidates: standards (data/standards/assets), case (the case's constant/assets), local (data/local/assets, UNVERIFIED). Absent = all three. A witness declares `( standards case )` so its golden does not depend on one machine's private records.

carrier.title: Membrane record for elements that name none
carrier.description: An imported element names no membrane; this NF or RO membrane record supplies its type and the starting water permeance (the permeance is then derived from the element's own rated test). Absent = such elements are excluded with that reason.

conditions.title: The student's operating conditions
conditions.description: Nothing here is defaulted; a missing key refuses by name.

feedMassFraction.title: Solute mass fraction in the feed

pH.title: Feed pH (optional)
pH.description: When given, a record's pH limits filter and their margin (pH units) is published; absent, no pH filter.

operation.title: Film, pressure drop and polarisation
operation.description: The blocks a spiralWoundModule unit writes in its operation (massTransfer, pressureDrop, polarisation, nNodes, rho_feed, ...) and `P_permeate` (required). The op supplies module, transport and rejection itself; module, membrane, transport, transportParameters, elements and vessels written here are replaced. Read by the module probes, not by the op.

file.title: CSV of the side-by-side table
file.description: One row per candidate, status pass|excluded with the reason, then every criterion.
